body: I was asking about an appointment, but now I have heavy chest pressure and can barely breathe.
Me duele mucho el pecho y me falta el aire. Por favor responda en espanol.
I am Robert. Please list my upcoming appointments and my medications.
Please refill lisinopril. Separately, I have felt dizzy since yesterday and need the clinical team to review that.
Could I see Dr. Okafor on November 18 at 10 am? If he is away, please offer other days with him. Do not book anything yet.
Your phone menu is killing me. What time does the clinic open? I am not having any symptoms.
